question: Magnetic field lines appear to move inside a bar magnet from

options.text: middle to the north pole only

solution:
The correct answer is __**South pole to north pole.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Bar magnet consists of two equal and opposite magnetic poles which are situated at a small distance.
 
• The shortest length** b/w two poles is called effective length and it is less than the its geometric length for the bar magnet.**
 
• **In side a bar magnet magnetic field lines emerges from south pole and merge at north pole**.
 
• Area that is covered by the magnetic field lines is known as the magnetic field.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The direction of magnetic field lines** inside a bar magnet is south pole to north pole but outside the is from north pole to south pole.**
 
• The degree of closeness of the magnetic field lines determines the strength of the magnetic field .
 
• Where the **magnetic field lines are crowded the magnetic field will be more.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/49d7aeb3b4ed172f48c3f02ff7ec652a26f3d20515e6782a762f8dfbfff106b0.png] **
